summary: Representative Chromium verification of the public chat-canary passed on desktop 1365x900 and narrow 390x844. The durable thread and CURRENT projection rendered and survived reload; the composer correctly exposed transport_ready=false, preserved the canary text, showed the private-auth boundary, and produced zero false QUEUED/liveness claims. No iframe, websocket, horizontal overflow, obvious public secret, request failure, console error or uncaught page error was observed. This certifies the served fail-closed path only: authenticated transport and worker liveness remain explicitly uncertified.
